plan.description: All observations retained. Invalid clock/affinity/throttling/counter runs are labeled and repeated with the same variant. Four paired observations per build/game. Clock pass does not remove ASLR/cache/JIT/other-host variation. CPU time and cycles determine work; wall throughput is also reported. The isolated campaign reserves CPUs 7 and 15 from other user-space cgroups. Kernel interrupts remain possible; sibling activity is measured. Corrected isolation: benchmark controller, measurement monitor and browser support threads all exclude the reserved core.
